$description: Semantic text roles — nexus defaults (ivory on obsidian).

disabled.$description: Disabled/inactive text. WCAG 1.4.3-exempt but held to the project floor ≥3:1 on every surface and ≥4.5:1 on surface.panel (NQ-091).

link.$description: AA link text; follows the active assistant accent, which themes tune for their shell polarity.

onArt.$description: Pinned-light text for always-dark authored surfaces (game felt/cloth/log). No theme may override — art is theme-invariant.

onArtDim.$description: Secondary text on authored-dark surfaces — same pin rule as text.onArt.

onArtMuted.$description: Tertiary/caption text on authored-dark surfaces — same pin rule as text.onArt.
